line: Check on a friend who's been quiet lately.
paragraph: Jane Johnson, who co-owns a gym in Kaysville, Utah, and teaches a barre fitness program, had watched a young woman for several years. She noticed the 22-year-old remembered routines with unusual ease. The young woman has Down Syndrome. Johnson helped her get certified as an instructor for the UpBeat Barre program. She now leads a class of sixty people. Someone quiet in your own life may be waiting for the right person to notice what they can do.
